mapper.insert: insert into t_entitlement_order ( order_no, user_id, client_request_id, product_code, order_type, entitlement_mode, grant_seconds, amount_cents, paid_amount_cents, refunded_amount_cents, status, expire_time, paid_time, fulfilled_time, close_time, close_reason, remark, version, create_time, update_time ) values( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{clientRequestId}, #{productCode}, #{orderType}, #{entitlementMode}, #{grantSeconds}, #{amountCents}, #{paidAmountCents}, #{refundedAmountCents}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{paidTime}, #{fulfilledTime}, #{closeTime}, #{closeReason}, #{remark}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) on duplicate key update order_id = last_insert_id(order_id)
